title: Experimental demonstration of the absence of noise-induced barren plateaus using information content landscape analysis
summary: Variational quantum algorithms are promising candidates for near-term quantum computing but can be hindered by barren plateaus, where gradients vanish exponentially and optimization becomes intractable. Noise-Induced Barren Plateaus (NIBP) are particularly concerning because they are predicted to arise generically from noise accumulation, independent of system size, circuit structure, and observable locality.
